text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just the fact that you tried for my sake
makes me super happy.
So please, don't worry about it at all~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Shall we grab something sweet?!
Like manju buns... or, ooh, cake maybe?!
Japanese sweets, Western pastries—I'm down for whatever! Deal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
